consumeRange(uint256,uint64,uint64,uint2.details: The lower bound is inclusive on the cumulative earnings axis. A zero lower timestamp starts from the beginning of the position. Call path: MiningSystem.withdrawNormal/withdrawImmediate/consumeComposition -> MiningEarningsLedger.consumeRange.

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC-1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

updatePosition(uint256,uint256,uint256,u.details: Call path: MiningSystem activation/mint-fee/acceleration/exit action -> MiningEarningsLedger.updatePosition.

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

accelerationClosedAt().notice: Returns the permanent acceleration shutdown timestamp, or zero while acceleration remains open.

checkpointCount(uint256).notice: Returns the number of rate checkpoints for one position.

closeAccelerationPermanently(uint64).notice: Permanently caps acceleration earnings while leaving base earnings unchanged.

configureMiningSystem(address).notice: Sets the only MiningSystem proxy allowed to write checkpoints and consume earnings.

constructor.notice: Creates the implementation and fixes its initial owner.

consumeRange(uint256,uint64,uint64,uint2.notice: Consumes unconsumed earnings produced inside one timestamp range, oldest first, up to a USDT maximum.

consumedTotals(uint256).notice: Returns the cumulative consumed base and acceleration USDT values for one position.

earningsStatus(uint256,uint64).notice: Returns cumulative produced, matured, consumed, and currently available earnings for one position.

positionAccelerationStatus(uint256).notice: Returns current acceleration stake-cycle data and earning rate for one position.

totalAccelerationMobStaked().notice: Returns the MÖB principal currently locked for acceleration across all positions.

updatePosition(uint256,uint256,uint256,u.notice: Replaces the current earning rates after settling the prior checkpoint up to the current second.
